problems.name: Local AI runtime for large codebases

quotes.author: jph
quotes.text: If you ask who would pay for Apple local models, I would. A Mac Studio high end 512GB costs ~$1000/month for 3 years versus my current run rate of ~$1000/month for five devs for Claude Ultra (or ~$10k/week for Claude Sonnet if I paid API…

problems.summary: Developers need to run large AI models locally on extensive codebases efficiently, but existing solutions are either too slow, memory‑intensive, or require cloud services, limiting real‑time analysis and privacy.

problems.name: Centralized processor die image repository

problems.name: Non-wireless Android device for exams

quotes.author: mapierce2

problems.name: Cache SSH key signing

problems.summary: Users want to cache SSH key signing to reduce latency and avoid repeated signing, but existing solutions lack efficient caching or touch support.

problems.name: Kid usage monitoring app

problems.name: GPU arbitrage marketplace

problems.name: Direct HV connection for battery charging

problems.name: Filter non-AI apps in App Store

quotes.author: bemtevi
quotes.text: I wish there was a filter in the app store to filter and only show apps that having nothing to do with AI. It's become increasingly hard to find a decent, non-AI app these days.

problems.name: Per‑site audio/video permission control

quotes.author: account42

problems.name: Casio watch lacking heart rate only feature
